en.stem: In a village council election, 10% of the votes were invalid. The winner got 62.5% of the valid votes and won by 258750 votes. Find the total number of votes polled.
en.explanation:
Shortcut:
25% of 1035000 votes = 258750
90% of total votes = 1035000
Total votes = 1150000

Using the percentage relation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
62.5 - 37.5
= 25%
Effective valid votes:
258750 x 100 / 25
= 1035000
Total votes are:
1035000 x 100 / 90
= 1150000
Total votes = 1150000

105 + 105
= 210
Marks percentage gap:
Pass mark difference =
70 - 40
= 30
Maximum marks are:
210 x 100 / 30
= 700
Maximum marks = 700

en.stem: In a municipal election, 80% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 20% votes were invalid. The winner got 65% of the valid votes and won by 417600 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Margin percentage =
65 - 35
= 30%
Effective valid votes =
417600 x 100 / 30
= 1392000
Votes polled =
1392000 x 100 / 80
= 1740000
Registered voters =

= 84150

Female population after reduction:

93500 x ( 100 - 5 ) / 100
= 88825

Final population:
84150 + 88825
= 172975

Hence, final population = 172975

en.stem: In a scholarship exam, 50% of the paper has been evaluated. A student scored 60% of those marks. To secure 60% overall, the student still needs 780 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Marks already secured:
50 x 60 / 100
= 30

Extra marks required:
Required marks gap =
60 - 30
= 30

Maximum marks are:
780 x 100 / 30
= 2600

Maximum marks = 2600

en.stem: In a district population survey, the total population was 260000. Males were 50% and females were the rest. The male population increased by 20%, while the female population decreased by 10%. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Male population:
260000 x 50 / 100
= 130000
Female population:
260000 - 130000
= 130000
Male population after growth:
130000 x (100 + 20) / 100
= 156000
Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
130000 x ( 100 - 10 ) / 100
= 117000
Final population:
156000 + 117000
= 273000
Hence, final population = 273000

Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
55 - 45
= 10%
Effective valid votes:
158400 x 100 / 10
= 1584000
Votes polled are:
1584000 x 100 / 80
= 1980000
Registered voters are:
1980000 x 100 / 80
= 2475000
Therefore, total votes = 2475000

163350 + 172425
= 335775

= 204000
Female population after reduction:

170000 x ( 100 - 10 ) / 100
= 153000

204000 + 153000
= 357000

62.5 - 37.5

357750 x 100 / 25
= 1431000
Votes polled are:
1431000 x 100 / 90
= 1590000
Registered voters are:
1590000 x 100 / 60
= 2650000
Hence, total votes polled = 2650000

en.stem: According to a census report, the total population was 420000. Males were 50% and females were the rest. The male population increased by 20%, while the female population decreased by 10%. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Male population:
420000 x 50 / 100
= 210000
Female population:
420000 - 210000
= 210000
Male population after growth:
210000 x (100 + 20) / 100
= 252000
Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
210000 x ( 100 - 10 ) / 100
= 189000
Final population:
252000 + 189000
= 441000
Accordingly, final population = 441000

220500 x (100 + 10) / 100
= 242550
Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
269500 x ( 100 - 5 ) / 100
= 256025

242550 + 256025
= 498575

Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
65 - 35
= 30%
Effective valid votes:
553500 x 100 / 30
= 1845000
Total votes are:
1845000 x 100 / 90
= 2050000
Therefore, total votes = 2050000

en.stem: In a student union election, 80% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 20% votes were invalid. The winner got 70% of the valid votes and won by 787200 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
70 - 30
= 40%

Effective valid votes:
787200 x 100 / 40
= 1968000

Votes polled are:
1968000 x 100 / 80
= 2460000

Registered voters are:
2460000 x 100 / 80
= 3075000

Total votes = 3075000

= 256500
Female population:
570000 - 256500
= 313500
Male population after growth:
256500 x (100 + 10) / 100
= 282150
Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
313500 x ( 100 - 5 ) / 100
= 297825
Final population:
282150 + 297825
= 579975
Final population = 579975

Male population:
580000 x 50 / 100
= 290000
Female population:
580000 - 290000
= 290000
Male population after growth:
290000 x (100 + 20) / 100
= 348000
Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
290000 x ( 100 - 10 ) / 100
= 261000
Final population:
348000 + 261000
= 609000
Accordingly, final population = 609000

en.stem: In a municipal election, 60% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 10% votes were invalid. The winner got 60% of the valid votes and won by 351000 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
60 - 40
= 20%
Effective valid votes:
351000 x 100 / 20
= 1755000
Votes polled are:
1755000 x 100 / 90
= 1950000
Registered voters are:
1950000 x 100 / 60
= 3250000
Hence, total votes polled = 3250000

en.stem: In a migration report, the population was 550000. It increased by 15%. In addition, people equal to 5% of the original population migrated in. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Population after increase:
550000 x 115 / 100
= 632500
Population added by migration:
550000 x 5 / 100
= 27500
Final population after migration:
632500 + 27500
= 660000
Accordingly, final population = 660000

650000 x 45 / 100
= 292500
Female population:
650000 - 292500
= 357500
Male population after growth:
292500 x (100 + 10) / 100
= 321750
Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
357500 x ( 100 - 5 ) / 100
= 339625
Final population:
321750 + 339625
= 661375
Final population = 661375

en.stem: In a district population survey, the total population was 660000. Males were 50% and females were the rest. The male population increased by 20%, while the female population decreased by 10%. Find the final population.
en.explanation:
Male population:
660000 x 50 / 100
= 330000

Female population:
660000 - 330000
= 330000

Male population after growth:
330000 x (100 + 20) / 100
= 396000

Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
330000 x ( 100 - 10 ) / 100
= 297000

Final population:
396000 + 297000
= 693000

Accordingly, final population = 693000

= 328500
Female population:
730000 - 328500
= 401500
Male population after growth:
328500 x (100 + 10) / 100
= 361350
Female population after reduction:
Female population after decrease =
401500 x ( 100 - 5 ) / 100
= 381425
Final population:
361350 + 381425
= 742775
Hence, final population = 742775

= 370000
Female population =
740000 - 370000

Male population after growth =
370000 x (100 + 20) / 100
= 444000
Female population after decrease =
370000 x ( 100 - 10 ) / 100
= 333000
Final population =
444000 + 333000
= 777000
Hence, final population = 777000

25% of 2385000 votes = 596250
90% of total votes = 2385000
Total votes = 2650000

Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
62.5 - 37.5
= 25%
Effective valid votes:
596250 x 100 / 25
= 2385000
Total votes are:
2385000 x 100 / 90
= 2650000
Total votes = 2650000

en.stem: In a village council election, 10% of the votes were invalid. The winner got 62.5% of the valid votes and won by 596250 votes. Find the total number of votes polled.
en.explanation:
Direct relation:
25% of 2385000 votes = 596250
90% of total votes = 2385000
Total votes = 2650000

Using the percentage relation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
62.5 - 37.5
= 25%
Effective valid votes:
596250 x 100 / 25
= 2385000
Total votes are:
2385000 x 100 / 90
= 2650000
Total votes = 2650000

710000 x 115 / 100
= 816500
Population added by migration:
710000 x 5 / 100
= 35500
Final population after migration:
816500 + 35500
= 852000
Accordingly, final population = 852000

en.explanation:
Total marks gap:
1020 + 1020
= 2040
Marks percentage gap:
Pass mark difference =
75 - 45
= 30
Maximum marks are:
2040 x 100 / 30
= 6800
Thus, maximum marks = 6800

= 912000
Population added by migration:
760000 x 8 / 100
= 60800
Final population after migration:
912000 + 60800
= 972800
Final population = 972800

364500 x (100 + 10) / 100
= 400950

Female population after reduction:

445500 x ( 100 - 5 ) / 100

400950 + 423225
= 824175

en.stem: In a student union election, 60% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 10% votes were invalid. The winner got 55% of the valid votes and won by 207900 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
en.explanation:
Winning margin:
Margin percentage =
55 - 45
= 10%
Effective valid votes:
207900 x 100 / 10
= 2079000
Votes polled are:
2079000 x 100 / 90
= 2310000
Registered voters are:
2310000 x 100 / 60
= 3850000
Therefore, total votes = 3850000

en.stem: In an urban-rural population report, the total population was 890000. Males were 45% and females were the rest. The male population increased by 10%, while the female population decreased by 5%. Find the final population.

Male population =
890000 x 45 / 100
= 400500
Female population =
890000 - 400500
= 489500
Male population after growth =
400500 x (100 + 10) / 100
= 440550
Female population after decrease =
489500 x ( 100 - 5 ) / 100
= 465025
Final population =
440550 + 465025
= 905575
Final population = 905575
